_meta.purpose: Win-rate tuned saved strategies (NIFTY / FINNIFTY CE Buy + NIFTY option selling). Reproducible record of the exact configs that were saved to the live DB (strategies table) with their real-engine backtest results.
_meta.engine: core/services/backtest_engine.py (ENGINE_VERSION v5) + realistic fill model (0.5% slippage + 3-tick spread floor + actual charges)
notes: Win rate 95% + positive profit dono saath is data par nahi mila - 95% wale configs ka PnL negative tha (PF < 1). Ye profitable configs hain, fake 95% nahi.
Loss side ka asli source: (a) 15:15 tak hold karne par last-hour theta decay, (b) gap-through SL fills. Isliye quality entry gate + early time exit + wide (90% = practical wipe-out) SL.
SL 90% ka matlab: premium ka 90% ghata tabhi cut - intraday me rare. No-SL vs SL 90% backtest numbers identical aaye.
Paper/live me wahi SL/TP DB values use hote hain; Edit SL/TP se turant change hota hai.

BANKNIFTY #53 bhi 11-Nov ko honest engine par re-backtest hua: SL 20% config loss-making tha (-Rs32,723, 67.91% WR) - 20% SL par gap-through fills. SL 90% (user ka original 'no leg stop-loss' intent) par: 124 trades, 73.39% WR, +Rs15,220, PF 1.15. Saved result ab stale_engine=False.

11-Nov late-evening: SL 90% revert karke user ke kehne par SL 20% / TP 7% wapas lagaya (user: 'kal tak jaisa profit de rahi thi'). Honest backtest (engine v5 + real fills): 180 trades, 67.22% WR, -Rs35,587 (gap-through SL fills avg loss 2,902). Paper (corrected): 11 trades, 81.8% WR, +Rs1,283 (9W/2L) - sample chhota hai. Saved BT ab 67.2% WR / -Rs35,587 dikhata hai; SL 90% wala config (+Rs15,220 / 73.4% WR) docs me bhi record hai.

PAPER fix ke baad: target exits ab LEVEL par hote hain (pehle current quote par - fake +42% target). Stale broker quote (prev_close par entry) guard bhi add hua. Dono parity RULE-LEVEL par hain; paper WR ka backtest se 100% match isliye abhi bhi data-source (historical vs live) se limited hai - lekin rules/fill-model/exit ab identical hain, aur parity endpoint (id/parity) parity proof deta hai.

11-Nov night: user ne 'net_pnl 65000 se adhik' maanga (1 lot hi rakhna). REALISTIC fills ke saath 1 lot par 65k reachable NAHI hai - TP ladder 3..50 sweep kiya (sweep15): BANKNIFTY max +Rs55,075 (TP50/SL90, 58.7% WR), FINNIFTY +Rs24,359 (TP20, 61.5%), NIFTY Buy +Rs12,884 (TP50, 66.7%), NIFTY Sell +Rs6,851 (TP40, 66.7%). Sabhi 4 strategies ab PnL-max TP par save hain. WR kam hai (59-67%) kyunki bada TP sirf tab hit hota hai jab premium bahut tez move kare. 65k+ ke liye lots badhane padenge (user ne 1 lot ka hi kaha).

key_findings: Har-bar auto signal (koi indicator nahi) par WR 69-83% aur PnL bade negative - signal quality hi asli driver hai.
TP 2-3% + time exit 13:45/14:00 = WR up, loss size down.
Trailing 'lock' (breakeven lock) scratch exits ko 'loss' dikhata hai -> WR girata hai, isliye use nahi kiya.
NIFTY CE sell (option selling) har config me negative tha; sirf PE sell profitable nikla.
SL 20% + gap fills = avg_loss 1700-5000 (catastrophic); SL 90% (wipe-out) + early exit = avg_loss 800-1700.

parity_fixes_2026-11-11.paper_tp_exit_at_level: Paper monitor TP hit par LEVEL par exit karta hai (pehle current quote par - fake +42% target profit). Backtest parity.
parity_fixes_2026-11-11.stale_quote_guard: Fyers lp aaj ke traded range (low/high) ke bahar ho to stale maankar reject (pehle stale prev_close par entry lag rahi thi - aaj kabhi trade nahi hua premium).
